hints: "Read emails (IMAP)": the original used Mailbox (IMAP original); check the mapped googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FETCH_EMAILS params before running.
"Send email to A.I. to summarize" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).

"Send email to A.I. to summarize" called the OpenRouter API (meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct:free) over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
"Send summarized content to messenger" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Summarize emails with A.I.
You can find out more about the [use case](https://rumjahn.com/how-a-i-saved-my-kids-school-life-and-my-marriage/)

Find your email server's IMAP Settings. 
- Link for [gmail](https://www.getmailspring.com/setup/access-gmail-via-imap-smtp)

For the A.I. you can use Openrouter.ai. 
- Set up a free account
- The A.I. model selected is FREE to use.
## Credentials
- Use header auth
- Username: Authorization
- Password: Bearer {insert your API key}.
- The password is "Bearer" space plus your API key.

Don't use the official Line node. It's outdated.
## Credentials
- Use header auth
- Username: Authorization
- Password: Bearer {channel access token}

You can find your channel access token at the [Line API console](https://developers.line.biz/console/). Go to Messaging API and scroll to the bottom.
